title: Bloom target distribution (generic pedagogical default curve)
description: A GENERIC instructional-design default target curve for the course-level Bloom-level mix consumed by lib/validators/bloom_distribution.py::BloomDistributionValidator. Contains ZERO corpus content — only six canonical-level -> share floats (understand+apply-weighted with a small evaluate+create tail) plus three derived band ceilings/floors. Operator overrides arrive via ED4ALL_BLOOM_DISTRIBUTION_TARGET (path or inline JSON), never a hardcoded path. Shares sum to ~1.0 over the canonical lib/ontology/bloom.py::BLOOM_LEVELS axis.
